headline: Cheapest Saturday in eight weeks, but the leads were the richest
commentary:
- **$6,983 NP at 26.9% NM** — triple last Saturday's $2,065, on $2,001 less spend and $2,916 more true commission.
- **Value, not volume**: Search EPL $36.10 vs $26.52, on fewer clicks (1,213 vs 1,441) and a dearer CPC of $13.89.
- Every tree beat its 7-day EPL — Test $38.85 vs $26.08, Direct (ZP) $32.05 vs $21.94 — likely Oliver's 24/09 tier changes bedding in.
- Spend mix swung hard: **speed $1,351 vs $8,615** last Saturday, payday_alternative $6,226 vs $2,977 — no note explains the switch.
- NP beats the 8-week Saturday mean of $4,804, but 1,557 leads is the lowest of those eight; EPL $16.66 mid-range.
- Facebook -$431 and TikTok -$266 bled again at sub-$2 EPLs; MTD they are -$7,958 and -$6,454 of pure drag.
watch: If speed stays near $1,351/day with impression share under 10%, confirm that is deliberate rather than an unnoticed bidding pullback.
Check Google conversion imports: roughly 93 campaign conversions logged yesterday against 766 last Saturday, echoing the 23-24/09 upload failure.
Watch whether Test tree EPL holds above $30 today; a second day would separate Oliver's 24/09 tier change from noise.
